name: tools_moirai_venv
description: Build and check the moirai venv (dftracer wheel with one shared libdftracer_core, moirai wheel rebuilt from HEAD, pydftracer common.py overlay, dftracer-utils) in a session on a system that has none (mammoth, Slurm). Load when explore_validate fails on moirai or dftracer_utils, MOIRAI_AGENTS_MOIRAI_PYTHON points to a missing venv, 'ModuleNotFoundError dftracer_utils', two libdftracer_core copies, 'ninja: build stopped' on rocksdb with gcc 10, or a stale moirai wheel.

history.why: Chat d8e7b5f4c86b (Annotate: tax-teller) built the moirai venv on mammoth by hand in about 30 Bash calls after the user chose 'Build the venv in the session on this system'. The recipe (python/3.12.2 module, PyPI dftracer wheel repaired to one core copy, prebuilt moirai wheel stale so rebuilt with gcc 12 on a pdebug node, pydftracer common.py overlay, dftracer-utils imports as dftracer.utils) is deterministic and was only a lesson on app_explore.
